title: Howie Roseman: I'm not answering the question any differently, A.J. Brown is an Eagle

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Howie Roseman: I'm not answering the question any differently, A.J. Brown is an Eagle
sources.description: "What do you think the odds are that I'm answering this question any different than I answered anywhere else?" Roseman said to a reporter who asked him about trading Brown.
